opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers toward paid mining-pool participation, including a $99 membership through a referral link and pool options priced at $500, $1,000, and $2,000. It describes purchasing computing power and promises that participants are “paid bitcoin every single day,” while part of the mined Bitcoin is used to acquire additional share percentages. It also ties bonuses to sponsored participants’ purchases and promotes daily earnings and coin-appreciation claims, including hypothetical increases to $7 or $12, without evidence of realized payouts or value. The cautions against borrowing and the denial that it is a Ponzi do not resolve the central assurances that viewers are “NOT LOSING ANYTHING,” or the encouragement to join.
